data.narrative:
Voyant Photonics is a Series A chip & semiconductor company founded by Chris Phare and Steven Miller that has raised $23M to date. The broader Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 11 peers across public and private markets, including 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers such as SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

Given the lack of sufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers with disclosed valuations, peer-median analysis is not applicable. The stage-progression method is the primary triangulation tool employed here. Using total capital raised ($23M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progressions yields an implied valuation of $46M. This reflects the expected capital increase between financing rounds in the semiconductor subsector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $39M (low) to $53M (high), with a median of $46M. This range is derived from a single applicable method, creating material uncertainty. Key risks to valuation include the depth and relevance of stage-progression multiples in frontier semiconductor segments, where capital intensity and timeline-to-revenue vary significantly. Additional uncertainty stems from the inability to anchor against narrow peer sets, making the 2.0x multiplier assumption the dominant driver of value. A fuller assessment would benefit from revenue or technical-milestone data, neither of which is presently available.
